decisive_items: completed a course of prostate-directed radiation therapy
large deep-cratered solitary ulcer on the anterior rectal wall with firm margins, friability, and exudate
Biopsies of the lesion were negative for malignancy
response.rationale: Post-radiation anterior rectal wall ulcer in a recently irradiated prostate cancer patient is most consistent with radiation proctitis; R1 merely describes the ulcer without the causal temporal context.

rejected.why: Restates the endoscopic finding but lacks the strong temporal and anatomic link to recent prostate-directed radiation therapy; negative biopsy does not exclude radiation injury.
